metadata.title: Minimalist Studio Portrait with Refrigerator and Magnetic Lettering

retrievalProfile.description: A clean, high-key studio portrait featuring a central white appliance used as a canvas for colorful, toy-like magnetic typography.
triggerTerms: white studio background with retro fridge
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body studio shot against a seamless white backdrop featuring a man leaning against a vintage-style white refrigerator, while a toddler interacts with the appliance. The refrigerator serves as the primary typographic anchor, displaying multi-colored magnetic letters.
coreVisualRelationships: Man leaning on the left side of the refrigerator
Toddler reaching up toward the center of the refrigerator
Typography centered on the upper door of the refrigerator
High-key lighting creating a seamless transition between floor and wall
coreInvariants: The refrigerator must be solid white with rounded retro corners.
Typography must appear as physical 3D magnetic letters in primary and secondary colors.
The background must be a pure white infinity cove.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are centrally grouped; the refrigerator occupies the vertical center, flanked by the man on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white refrigerator acts as the central pillar and canvas for the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the man's face down to the guitar, across to the colorful text, and down to the toddler.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounds the central subjects to emphasize simplicity.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Earth tones (olive pants, tan striped shirt)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Multi-color primary palette (red, blue, green, yellow, orange letters)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation environment with high saturation pops in the lettering.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid complex gradients in the background
Limit text colors to a toy-like plastic palette

letterConstructionRules: Letters must mimic plastic injection-molded magnetic toys
Rounded edges and uniform stroke thickness
Slightly irregular baseline to suggest manual placement
Each character is a single solid color
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'i' and 'f' mixed with uppercase for a playful, naive look

treatment.shadow: subtle drop shadow to suggest 3D depth

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single style with varied colors and sizes to create internal hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Physical interaction between subject and text

candidateDirections.reason: Similar geometric skeleton and rounded terminals.
Captures the playful, slightly irregular energy.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio photo of a man with a guitar leaning on a white retro fridge and a toddler reaching up, against a pure white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add 3D magnetic-style plastic letters in various colors to the upper door of the fridge, ensuring they have soft shadows to look attached.

adjustableVariables: Appliance type (e.g., locker instead of fridge)
mustRedesign: Any flat 2D digital fonts that lack 3D depth
postGenerationChecks: Is the text centered on the fridge?
Do the letters look like plastic magnets?
Is the background pure white without a visible floor line?
Are the colors of the letters distinct and vibrant?
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + [Subject] + [White Retro Appliance] + [Magnetic Letter Typography] + High-key lighting
